items.claim: As of the requested cutoff, 2026 regular-season performance does not exist: league kickoff is September 9.
Philadelphia identifies September 13 against Washington as its regular-season opener.
August 11 practice included a well-timed intermediate completion to Goedert, but another completed play would have ended in a sack before the throw.

unavailable: Verified complete 2026 preseason passing and snap totals
current_season_performance.public_substitute: Dated camp observations and explicitly labeled 2025 historical statistics.
current_season_performance.limitation: Camp observations cannot establish regular-season efficiency or justify projecting a new performance level.

items.claim: The 2025 regular-season row records 16 games and starts, 294 completions on 454 attempts, 64.8% completion, 3,224 yards, 7.1 yards/attempt, 25 touchdowns, six interceptions, 98.5 passer rating, and 55.2 QBR.
Official team totals independently confirm 3,224 passing yards, 25 touchdowns, six interceptions, and 98.49 passer rating.

passing_production_efficiency.limitation: Satisfied for the latest completed regular season only. Production reflects receiving, protection, scheme, and workload as well as quarterback execution.

items.claim: PFF's public 2025 Regular table gives Hurts a 77.2 passing grade, 532 dropbacks, 9.2-yard average target depth, and 3.09-second average time to throw.
Yards Per Pass reports Hurts at 0.09 EPA/dropback, +3.18 CPOE, 47.4% success, and 6.76 ANY/A.

unavailable: Independent reproduction of public EPA/CPOE filters and denominators
advanced_passing_metrics.public_substitute: Public nflverse-derived EPA/CPOE table, alongside independently charted PFF measures.
advanced_passing_metrics.limitation: The common table contains discrepancies from conventional official statistics. Its model outputs are provisional comparisons, not interchangeable with NGS or independently recomputed results.

items.claim: PFF reports a 16.6% pressure-to-sack rate for Hurts.
Opta reports 88.3% well-thrown passes on the move, 8.26 air yards/attempt, and a 3.90% pickable-pass rate; the qualifying threshold was 50 attempts on the move.

unavailable: Pressure-subset attempt counts, completion percentage, EPA, and passing grade
pressure_performance.public_substitute: Pressure-to-sack rate directly measures sack conversion under charted pressure. On-the-move charting adds movement evidence.
pressure_performance.limitation: Movement is not synonymous with pressure. Searches also returned generic season totals under pressure-query titles and an uncorroborated community claim; neither was accepted as a verified pressure passing split.

items.claim: PFF reports a 9.2-yard average target depth, describing throw selection rather than depth-specific accuracy.
The official situational page groups passing by attempt sequence, field position, game half, and other situations; those groupings do not establish short, intermediate, and deep air-yard accuracy.

unavailable: Depth-specific adjusted completion, on-target percentage, or CPOE
accuracy_by_depth.public_substitute: Aggregate CPOE and average target depth provide separate contextual measures, not a replacement depth-accuracy matrix.
accuracy_by_depth.limitation: Targeted deep-ball searches and public PFF/NGS/PFR checks did not yield a verified complete Hurts depth table. NGS returned no extractable content; direct PFR access failed. Exact-trait accuracy calibration remains unsupported.

items.claim: PFF reports a 2.0% turnover-worthy play rate, tied for fourth-lowest among qualifying quarterbacks; four of Hurts' six interceptions came against the Chargers.
The PFF public regular-season player table lists 11 turnover-worthy plays.
The official total-fumbles table lists eight fumbles and four lost; the separate rushing table's four FUM must not be treated as total fumbles.

unavailable: PFF play-level classifications and precise published rate denominator
turnover_worthy_mistakes.public_substitute: Official interceptions and total fumbles provide outcome-based corroboration.
turnover_worthy_mistakes.limitation: Turnover outcomes include recovery and interception luck; PFF charting is judgment-based. The article's season scope and rounding should be reconciled before deriving rates from its separate player table.

items.claim: Official rushing totals: 105 carries, 421 yards, 4.0 yards/carry, eight touchdowns, 40 first downs, and two runs of at least 20 yards.
CBS charted nine Week 1 scrambles for 63 yards, two touchdowns and five first downs, excluding kneeldowns.
Joint-practice reporting documents quarterback draws and a busted designed run, establishing that designed running was practiced.

unavailable: Full-season designed-run versus scramble counts and yards
rushing_designed_run_value.public_substitute: Official aggregate rushing plus explicitly limited single-game scramble charting.
rushing_designed_run_value.limitation: Aggregate rushing combines different play types and kneeldowns. Practice usage does not establish future workload; no full-season split was extrapolated from Week 1.

items.claim: Hurts took 32 sacks for 181 yards; PFR reports a 6.58% sack rate. This denominator differs from a pressure-to-sack rate.
PFF's 16.6% pressure-to-sack rate supplies a direct pressured-dropback measure for Hurts.
PFF's annual summary reports Purdy at 9.0% pressure-to-sack, providing a stored-control comparison without changing the baseline.

unavailable: Full-season scramble EPA and conversion rate
scrambling_sack_avoidance.public_substitute: Conventional sack rate, charted pressure-to-sack rate, and limited scramble evidence.
scrambling_sack_avoidance.limitation: Neither sack measure isolates responsibility from protection, route timing, or defensive pressure quality.

items.claim: Official appearances were 17 games in 2023, 15 in 2024, and 16 in 2025.
The official log has no Hurts statistics for the 2025 Week 18 game and records his participation in the subsequent Wild Card game.
January 10 reporting described a return to practice after missing the final two 2024 regular-season games with a concussion.

unavailable: Comprehensive recent injury and practice chronology
durability_availability.public_substitute: Official appearances and game logs plus dated historical injury reporting.
durability_availability.limitation: Games without statistics are not automatically injury absences. Historical concussion evidence does not establish current impairment.

items.claim: Hurts is included among Philadelphia's quarterbacks on the initial active roster announced August 30.
August 20 reporting describes Hurts taking first-offense practice repetitions.
The official injury index retrieved during research still leads with January 10, 2026, and supplies no current August Hurts participation designation.

current_injury_practice_status.public_substitute: Current roster inclusion and dated practice participation.
current_injury_practice_status.limitation: Active-roster inclusion and prior practice participation do not certify full health. Searches through the cutoff did not resolve a current designation; this volatile category requires rechecking.

items.claim: Official identity: Jalen Hurts, Philadelphia quarterback, jersey 1, listed at 6-foot-1 and 223 pounds.
PFR records 16 starts and 454 pass attempts, establishing substantial starting workload in the latest completed season.
The current roster includes Hurts, Cole Payton, Andy Dalton, and Tanner McKee; the announcement explicitly orders players numerically, not by depth.

unavailable: Quantified current designed-run and under-center workload
role_workload.public_substitute: Previous-season starts and workload, current roster, and first-offense practice reporting.
role_workload.limitation: Current numerical roster order is not a depth chart. Future scheme and workload are not treated as established performance.

items.claim: Late-season results varied: Chargers 21/40, 240 yards, zero touchdowns and four interceptions; Raiders 12/15, 175 yards and three touchdowns; Washington 22/30, 185 yards and two touchdowns; Buffalo 13/27, 110 yards and one touchdown. The final three had no interceptions.
Against San Francisco in the Wild Card loss, Hurts completed 20/35 for 168 yards, one touchdown, no interceptions, and a 79.2 passer rating.
August 20 joint practice featured interceptions and would-be sacks, followed by improved red-zone execution. This is mixed camp evidence, not a regular-season trend.

recent_performance_trend.public_substitute: Official game-by-game outcomes plus separately labeled recent practice observations.
recent_performance_trend.limitation: Small and heterogeneous samples cannot establish sustained improvement or decline; opponent, game state, and practice rules differ.

items.claim: Rushing declined from 150 carries, 630 yards and 14 touchdowns in 2024 to 105 carries, 421 yards and eight touchdowns in 2025.
The team reports a 71.4% completion rate, 108.6 passer rating, 8.0 yards/attempt, ten total touchdowns and one turnover during the 2024 playoffs.
PFF describes 2025 as Hurts' fourth consecutive season with a top-12 passing grade.

prior_season_context.limitation: Historical playoff success and multi-season consistency provide context, not proof of unchanged current ability or any Madden attribute.

unavailable: Fully reconciled conventional production comparison for all three external controls
Matched exact-trait pressure, depth, and rushing comparisons
outside_control_comparisons.public_substitute: One common public table provides same-season efficiency comparisons against every supplied external control.
outside_control_comparisons.limitation: Mahomes, Jackson, and Goff remain the supplied external controls. Differing models and samples prevent treating these numbers as a complete calibration or a membership decision.

conflicts.topic: Common advanced table versus conventional statistics
conflicts.description: Yards Per Pass lists Hurts' passer rating as 98.9, versus the official team's 98.49. It also lists Allen with 16 games, while ESPN lists 17. These are retained as unresolved provider/sample differences rather than averaged.
conflicts.resolution: Use official team totals for Hurts' conventional statistics; treat the common advanced table as provisional and provider-specific.

conflicts.description: The team rushing table shows four FUM; the total-fumbles table shows eight fumbles and four lost.
conflicts.resolution: Use the total-fumbles table for overall ball-security outcomes; do not substitute the rushing-only column.

conflicts.description: Positive August 11 team observations coexist with August 20 struggles reported by an independent beat reporter. Neither is a representative regular-season sample.
conflicts.resolution: Preserve both observations and their dates; make no sustained-performance inference.

conflicts.description: PFR searches exposed regular-season rows, postseason rows, and separate historical shared-table snapshots. Direct page access returned 403.
conflicts.resolution: Accepted only the explicitly identified Hurts regular-season row, cross-checked against official totals; did not merge postseason or partial-season snapshots.
